summary: Mergeable with minor issues related to code style and documentation.

issues.description: The patch introduces a try-except block which is not necessary and can be removed.
The code could benefit from a docstring explaining the purpose of the try-except block and the UnicodeEncodeError exception.
While the automated tests pass, it would be beneficial to add additional tests to cover edge cases, such as strings containing multiple accents or non-ASCII characters.
